metrics.description: Metric time series (error rate, loss, throughput, tunnel state, TGW drops).

agent.name: netcortex-metrics-agent
agent.description: Analyzes metric time-series for anomaly windows and degradation signals.

skill.name: Analyze Metrics
skill.description: Analyze metrics in a time window and produce an AgentFinding.

anomaly.template: Metric anomalies detected on {hit_count}/{candidate_count} nodes; worst switch={worst.tags.switch}, error_rate={worst.error_rate:.2f}%, packet_loss={worst.packet_loss:.2f}%, throughput={worst.throughput_gbps:.2f}Gbps; evidence={worst.reasons}
Metric anomalies detected on {hit_count}/{candidate_count} entities; worst {worst.entity_type}={worst.entity_id}; evidence={worst.reasons}

log.description: Log events (application, network OS, FRR bgpd).

agent.name: netcortex-log-agent
agent.description: Analyzes log streams for correlated error and timeout patterns.

skill.name: Analyze Logs
skill.description: Analyze logs in a time window and produce an AgentFinding.

anomaly.template: Error patterns in logs: {hit_count} error/fatal events across {entity_count} services; top_service={top_entity}

routing.description: Routing changes and route-table state (paths, BGP, TGW routes).

agent.name: netcortex-routing-agent
agent.description: Analyzes routing events and topology changes around incidents.

skill.name: Analyze Routing
skill.description: Analyze routing events in a time window and produce an AgentFinding.

anomaly.template: Routing changes found: {hit_count} event(s); first_path={first.path_id}, change={first.change_type}, details={first.details}

config.description: Configuration changes (simulated change records, CloudTrail write calls).

agent.name: netcortex-config-agent
agent.description: Analyzes configuration changes proximate to incident windows.

skill.name: Analyze Config
skill.description: Analyze config changes in a time window and produce an AgentFinding.

anomaly.template: Incident-relevant config changes found: {hit_count} change(s); latest={latest.change_type} on {latest.component}
Incident-relevant config changes found: {hit_count} change(s); latest={latest.name} on {latest.entity_type}:{latest.entity_id}

clean.template: Config changes present ({candidate_count}) but not incident-relevant
